title: kubecon-2026-travel-admin-scratchpad
content:
Quick notes / TODO (scratchpad) for KubeCon North America 2026 trips and admin (team travel support)

Dates: May 18-21, 2026 (conference May 19-21). Team on-site window: May 17-22 (arrivals + buffer).

High level objectives:
- Onsite demos for Redwood Dedicated + console walkthroughs (booth demos).
- Customer meetings: Acme Corp (May 19 AM), GreenBank (May 20 PM).
- Capture feedback for autoscale + batching UX.

Flights / travel bookings:
- Confirmed: Jordan (SFO -> LAS) UA432, depart 2026-05-17 07:00 local, return UA789 2026-05-22 18:30. Keep receipts + boarding passes.
- Aisha: booked on AA123 (notes: seat change requested). Miguel: pending, remind to book by 2026-02-20.
- Reimbursement code: TRV-KC-2026 (expense form line).

Hotel / lodging:
- Hyatt Regency Las Vegas - group block under "Redwood Inference" (block code: RWKD26). Check-in 5/17, checkout 5/22.
- Front desk contact: +1-702-555-0148, events manager Maria Lopez (m.lopez@hyattexample.com).
- Note: invoice to be requested at checkout for company card reconciliation.

Booth / vendor contacts:
- Booth build: FastExpo (lead: Daniel Park, daniel@fastexpo.com, +1-303-555-0199). Booth #B12.
- AV: order includes 1x 65" monitor, HDMI split, 2x lapel mics. Confirm delivery date 5/18 morning.
- Swag vendor: BrandGoods Co. (order #BG-9921). Contact: Sara N. (sara@brandgoods.co). Need final headcount by 2026-03-15.

Onsite schedule (draft):
- 5/17 (Mon): Team arrivals, quick sync 7pm (hotel meeting room).
- 5/18 (Tue): Booth setup (AM), AV test, partner dinner (7pm).
- 5/19 (Wed): Morning: Acme demo 09:30-10:15. Booth hours 10:30-17:00. Evening: customer reception.
- 5/20 (Thu): Panels, meetings with GreenBank 14:00. Booth hours 10:30-16:00.
- 5/21 (Fri): Wrap, pack, last meetings. 

Expense reminders + guidance:
- Capture receipts for: flights, hotel incidentals, dinners >$75, taxi/Uber receipts, booth-related shipments.
- Use corporate card where possible; otherwise submit expense with receipt attached in Concur within 10 business days of travel.
- Per diem policy: team members should follow company meal limits (USD 75/day unless preapproved).
- Shipping to show: track FedEx/Freight shipments and save proof of delivery (BOL). Shipping account: RWKD-EXPO-77.

Vendor milestones / deadlines:
- Booth floorplan confirmation to FastExpo: due 2026-03-01.
- AV final specs to vendor: due 2026-03-15.
- Swag final artwork/upload: due 2026-03-10.
- Badge names upload to KubeCon portal: due 2026-04-15.

Contacts (quick list):
- Event organizer (KubeCon): events@cloudnative.cncf, phone +1-415-555-0182
- FastExpo (booth build): Daniel Park, daniel@fastexpo.com, +1-303-555-0199
- Hyatt events manager: Maria Lopez, m.lopez@hyattexample.com, +1-702-555-0148
- AV provider: SoundWave Rentals, av@swrentals.com, +1-702-555-0166 (contact: Kevin Chan)
- Swag: Sara N. (BrandGoods), sara@brandgoods.co, +1-415-555-0123

Quick packing checklist:
- Laptop + power brick, travel adapter, dongles (HDMI), portable hotspot, laser pointer
- Booth materials: business cards, one-pager printouts, swag (stickers, shirts), banner
- Presentation: USB backup, slide deck PDF uploaded to Confluence and personal drive

Open questions / actions:
- Miguel to confirm flight by 2026-02-20 (ACTION)
- Confirm budget approval for extra 2 monitors for booth (finance OK? tag: FIN-EXPO-26)
- Decide on giveaway quantity (target: 800 stickers, 200 shirts) by 2026-03-01
- Book local ground transport for VIP customer visits (driver + car) — reach out to GoLocal Limo

Reimbursement notes (for expense entries):
- Use project code: PROJ-INF-RED-2026 on Concur for demo-related spend.
- For booth-related shipping and AV, attach vendor invoice and BOL.

Notes to self:
- Keep a folder on Drive with: receipts-scans, boarding-passes, customer-card-photos, postmortem notes.
- Capture short demo video on demo laptop for post-event marketing.
- Quick retro template: what worked / what didn't / follow-ups (assign owners)

End of scratchpad. Will refine into meeting checklist + expense guide next update.
